text:
celine: Quick sync: customers want two things for Optimize toolkit next cycle — eval-triggered regression alerts (PD + Console) and a tiny mobile batching helper. I propose we ship alert plumbing + PD webhooks and a minimal batching snippet (JS/Kotlin). Defer quant profiles to post-beta. Agree?

omar: +1 to narrow scope. One decision: do we alert on eval-deltas only or include simple output-based signals (e.g., sudden increase in short-answer failures)? I'd start with eval-deltas for precision.

ryan: ML agrees: eval-delta templates are fastest to implement and least noisy. Example rule sketch:
```
if baseline_concordance - current_concordance > 0.06 AND sample_count >= 40 -> open alert
attach: top_10 failing_prompts + last_10 outputs
```

pat: Infra notes: we need per-tenant metric buckets, a durable alert queue, canary toggle, and a webhook tester for PD/Slack. I can deliver core infra in ~3 weeks if UI and ML freeze templates quickly.

megan: CS: Beta customers (AcmeHealth, Zephyr) requested quiet-hours for PD, and Zephyr wants a drop-in batching helper with simple defaults. I'll collect PD webhook details and a mobile connectivity trace from Zephyr.

celine: Proposed acceptance gates:
- Alerts fire on internal eval suite with reproducible samples and <5% false positives over 72h
- PD webhook and Console notification validated end-to-end for 2 beta tenants
- Batching helper + docs + JS/Kotlin snippets in repo
- Beta runbook + oncall owner assigned for 2 weeks post-beta

omar: I'll prepare 3 starter templates: concordance_delta, auc_drop, prompt_failure_rate and bundle a small eval pack for validation. Will freeze by Monday.

ryan: UI plan (ryan): simple template picker + numeric threshold + per-tenant enable toggle. Inbox: compact list with sample payload preview. Need an API: /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=...

pat: I'll expose the API and add alert_delivery_latency_ms metric. Also adding retry semantics for webhooks and a canary flag for tenant enablement.

megan: I'll produce the beta onboarding checklist and include PD webhook steps, quiet-hours guidance, and escalation playbook.

celine: Owners: pat(infra), omar(ML/templates), ryan(UI), megan(customer ops). I'll coordinate milestones. Target beta handoff in ~5 weeks. Keep scope strict: no full rule-builder, no cost-anomaly alerts, deferring quantization.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Optimize toolkit - beta launch planning" on 2025-04-10 09:00 PT. Invited: celine, omar, ryan, pat, megan.

ryan: I'll post UI mocks by Wed.

omegar: (typo) - meant omar.

celine: Thanks all. If anyone thinks we need to expand scope to include quant or cost alarms before beta, call it out now. Otherwise we ship narrow and iterate. :rocket:
